title: Kenyan-Style Bacon Skillet
description: A flavorful and spicy skillet dish made with crispy bacon, Kenyan spices, and lively vegetables.

ingredients.name: lively vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: such as coconut or avocado oil

instructions: Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the Kenyan spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Return the cooked bacon to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the lively vegetable oil to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
